                             - Code to replicate plots and analyses of: A record-breaking heatwave reduces breeding success and impairs growth in a wild bird population -
                                                            Analysing heatwave effects on the number of fledglings and nestling mass

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(readr)
```

BODY MASS

Load data and compute sample size per group for SM
```{r}
data_mass <- read_csv("data_mass.csv")

samplesize<-data_mass %>% 
  select(mass_m_c, period, heatwave_year, sp, Section, cs, pnum, year, Mother) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  group_by(period,heatwave_year) %>% 
  summarise(sample=length(mass_m_c)) %>% 
  ungroup()

samplesize
```

Model the effects of the heatwave
```{r}
#Model with the triple interaction to test species differences 
mod1<-lmer(mass_m_c~period*heatwave_year*sp+Section+cs+(1|pnum)+(1|year)+(1|Mother), data=data_mass)
summary(mod1) 
anova(mod1) 

mod2<-lmer(mass_m_c~period*heatwave_year+sp+Section+cs+(1|pnum)+(1|year)+(1|Mother), data=data_mass)
summary(mod2) 
anova(mod2)

#changes per group
emm_mass <- emmeans(mod2, ~ period * heatwave_year)

period_diffs_mass <- emmeans(emm_mass, pairwise ~ period | heatwave_year)$contrasts
diff_df_mass <- as.data.frame(confint(period_diffs_mass)) #
diff_df_mass

#contrast differences
int_con_mass <- contrast(emm_mass, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"))
summary(int_con_mass, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))  
emm_mass_df <- as.data.frame(emm_mass)
```

Plot
```{r}
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.2)
emm_mass_df$period <- factor(emm_mass_df$period, levels = c("pre", "post"))

effects_mass<-ggplot(emm_mass_df, aes(x = period, y = emmean, color = heatwave_year, 
                    group = heatwave_year)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, position = pd) +
  geom_point(size = 5, position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE), width = 0.05, position = pd) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "#2A9D8F", "yes" = "#E8927C")) +
  labs(y = expression("Mean predicted mass"["centred"]), x = "Period")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("pre" = "Pre-heatwave", "post" = "Heatwave")) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  theme(
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +

  # blue group: Δ + 95% CI, to the right of "post"
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = -1.8, 
           label = "Δ = -1.02±0.06", 
           color = "#2A9D8F", size = 6, hjust = 0) +

  # orange group: Δ + 95% CI, to the right of "post"
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = -2, 
           label = "Δ = -2.06±0.38", 
           color = "#E8927C", size = 6, hjust = 0) +

  # p-value for the difference between the two deltas
 annotate("text", x = 1, y = -2.2, 
           label = "p[diff] == 0.006", 
           color = "grey40", size = 5, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE, fontface="bold")+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(0.9, 2))

effects_mass
```

Reanalysis with the phenologically most similar years
```{r}
median_ld <- read_csv("median_ld.csv")

#get the earliest years in the dataset (not including 2026, the earliest) and then add 2026 to repeat the models with the most similat data
yrs_q05 <- c(median_ld$year[median_ld$median_ld <= quantile(median_ld$median_ld, 0.05)], 2026)
yrs_q10 <- c(median_ld$year[median_ld$median_ld <= quantile(median_ld$median_ld, 0.10)], 2026)
yrs_q25 <- c(median_ld$year[median_ld$median_ld <= quantile(median_ld$median_ld, 0.25)], 2026)
yrs_q50 <- c(median_ld$year[median_ld$median_ld <= quantile(median_ld$median_ld, 0.50)], 2026)
```

Closer 5%
```{r}
data_mass_5per<-data_mass %>%
  filter(year%in%yrs_q05)

mod1_5per<-lmer(mass_m_c~period*heatwave_year*sp+Section+cs+(1|pnum)+(1|year)+(1|Mother), data=data_mass_5per)
summary(mod1_5per) 
anova(mod1_5per) 

mod2_5per<-lmer(mass_m_c~period*heatwave_year+sp+Section+cs+(1|pnum)+(1|year)+(1|Mother), data=data_mass_5per)
summary(mod2_5per) 
anova(mod2_5per)

#changes per group
emm_mass_5per <- emmeans(mod2_5per, ~ period * heatwave_year)

period_diffs_mass_5per <- emmeans(emm_mass_5per, pairwise ~ period | heatwave_year)$contrasts
diff_df_mass_5per <- as.data.frame(confint(period_diffs_mass_5per)) #
diff_df_mass_5per

int_con_mass_5per <- contrast(emm_mass_5per, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"))
summary(int_con_mass_5per, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))  
```
Repeat for the other thresholds

NUMBER OF FLEDGLINGS
```{r}
data_nfledglings <- read_csv("data_nfledglings.csv")

samplesize_nf<-data_nfledglings %>% 
  select(nf_c, period, heatwave_year, Species, Section, year, Mother) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  group_by(period,heatwave_year) %>% 
  summarise(sample=length(nf_c)) %>% 
  ungroup()

samplesize_nf
```

Model the effects of the heatwave
```{r}
#model to analyse potential species differences
mod_nf<-lmer(nf_c~period*heatwave_year*Species+Species+Section+(1|box)+(1|Mother)+(1|year), data=data_nfledglings)
summary(mod_nf)
anova(mod_nf) 

#final model
mod_nf_2<-lmer(nf_c~period*heatwave_year+Species+Section+(1|box)+(1|Mother)+(1|year), data=data_nfledglings)
summary(mod_nf_2)
anova(mod_nf_2) 

#change per group
emm_nf <- emmeans(mod_nf_2, ~ period * heatwave_year)

period_diffs_nf <- emmeans(emm_nf, pairwise ~ period | heatwave_year)$contrasts
diff_df_nf <- as.data.frame(confint(period_diffs_nf)) #differences no heatwave (-2.609517 [-2.849818 -2.369216]) vs heatwave (-4.476855 [-6.185111 -2.768598])
diff_df_nf

int_con_nf <- contrast(emm_nf, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"))
summary(int_con_nf, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))  # adds CI and test stat

emm_nf_df <- as.data.frame(emm_nf)
```

Plot
```{r}
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.2)
emm_nf_df$period <- factor(emm_nf_df$period, levels = c("pre", "post"))

effects_nf<-ggplot(emm_nf_df, aes(x = period, y = emmean, color = heatwave_year, 
                    group = heatwave_year)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, position = pd) +
  geom_point(size = 5, position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE), width = 0.05, position = pd) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "#2A9D8F", "yes" = "#E8927C")) +
 labs(y = expression("Mean predicted number of fledglings"["centred"]), x = "Period")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("pre" = "Pre-heatwave", "post" = "Heatwave")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-5.3, 2.3)) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  theme(
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  # blue group: Δ + 95% CI, to the right of "post"
  annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = -3.6, 
           label = "Δ = -2.60±0.12", 
           color = "#2A9D8F", size = 6, hjust = 0) +

  # orange group: Δ + 95% CI, to the right of "post"
  annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = -3.9, 
           label = "Δ = -4.47±0.87", 
           color = "#E8927C", size = 6, hjust = 0) +

  # p-value for the difference between the two deltas
 annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = -4.2, 
           label = "p[diff] == 0.033", 
           color = "grey40", size = 5, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE, fontface="bold")+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(0.9, 2))

effects_nf
```
